name: ARAFTA
description: Arafta (also known as Bound By Fate) is a 2025 Turkish drama that centers on a high-stakes enemies-to-lovers story driven by family vendettas and traumatic pasts.

name: Lovely Runner
description: Im Sol travels back in time to prevent the tragic fate of her favorite star, Ryu Sun Jae.

name: Business Proposal
description: a lighthearted and fast-paced Korean romantic comedy where a young office worker goes on a blind date in place of her friend, only to discover the man she is trying  to scare away is actually her company's handsome CEO.

name: Queen of Tears
description: a romantic K-drama that tells the love story of a married chaebol heiress and her small-town husband as they overcome a life-threatening crisis and rekindle their love against all odds.

name: My Demon
description: A  powerful, centuries-old demon who makes soul-bargains but loses his powers, becoming tethered to a cold heiress.

name: Goblin
description: A modern fantasy about a goblin who needs a human bride to end his immortal life.

name: Crash Landing on You
description: A South Korean heiress accidentally lands in North Korea and meets an army officer.

name: Vincenzo
description: During a visit to his motherland, a Korean-Italian mafia lawyer gives a conglomerate a taste of its own medicine with a side of justice.

name: All of Us Are Dead
description: A zombie virus outbreak traps students inside their high school.
